description: This Java source file defines the ConditionChecker utility class, which provides static methods for pre-condition and post-condition checks such as null checks, empty string/collection checks, and predicate-based argument validation. It is used for enforcing argument validity within the codebase.

classes.name: ConditionChecker
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to validate method arguments and conditions, such as null checks and emptiness checks, with customizable messages.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the argument is not null; throws NullPointerException if null.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the argument is not null with a custom message based on argument name.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the CharSequence is not empty; throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: checkNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the Collection is not empty; throws IllegalArgumentException if empty.

methods.name: checkArgument
methods.description: Checks an argument against a Predicate; throws IllegalArgumentException if predicate fails.

methods.name: checkArgument
methods.description: Checks an argument with a Predicate and a custom message supplier; throws IllegalArgumentException if predicate fails.

methods.name: argumentNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the argument is not null; throws IllegalArgumentException if null.

methods.name: argumentNotNull
methods.description: Ensures the argument is not null with argument name for message.

methods.name: argumentNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures CharSequence argument is not empty; throws exception if empty.

methods.name: argumentNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures CharSequence argument is not empty with argument name for message.
